error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE:
"[SCTP]   Received SCTP SHUTDOWN EVENT"

Context:
This SCTP shutdown event indicates that the SCTP association (assoc_id 337) between the CU and DU was terminated unexpectedly. Following this, the log shows the removal of the SCTP endpoint and the release of the DU ID 3584 (gNB-Eurecom-DU) on assoc_id 337. This event is critical as it breaks the SCTP connection required for F1AP messaging, effectively preventing further communication and operation between CU and DU, which would disrupt the 5G system operation.
